$comment: Unit coverage floors for src/**/*.{ts,tsx} (PBO-M2-1), measured with Vitest 5.1 and @vitest/coverage-v8 over every source file, loaded or not, on 2026-11-14. The pre-port 88.28 % branch baseline counted only files that tests imported and included scripts/, so it is not comparable. The floors may only rise (ecosystem 16, ratchets); lowering needs an ADR and the owner. Targets: 80 % branches on src/ and 90 % on auth, permissions and the DAL (testing.md section 1), reached through the component and integration projects and diff coverage on every PR.
